questions.prompt: Hannibal famously crossed the Alps to attack which power?
questions.fact: He won nearly every battle in Italy for fifteen years and still lost the war, because he could never take the city itself.

questions.prompt: Which scientist left gaps in his table to predict elements not yet discovered?
questions.fact: He predicted the properties of gallium and germanium years before anyone found them, and the measurements came back close to his numbers.

questions.prompt: Which boxer was universally known as The Greatest?
questions.fact: He was stripped of his title and banned from boxing for over three years at the peak of his career, then came back and regained it.

questions.prompt: Which musician was known as the King of Rock and Roll?
questions.fact: He never performed a full concert outside North America, despite being one of the most globally recognised performers of his era.

questions.prompt: Which country's name comes from the Spanish word for equator?
questions.fact: Because the planet bulges at the equator, its highest peak's summit is the furthest point from the centre of the Earth.

questions.prompt: In Hamlet, who murders the prince's father?
questions.fact: At roughly 4,000 lines it is Shakespeare's longest play, and is rarely performed uncut.

questions.prompt: Who co-founded Apple alongside Steve Jobs?
questions.fact: A third founder sold his 10 percent stake for 800 dollars less than two weeks in.
